name: ai-employee-intelligence-platform
description: AI Employee Intelligence Platform - foundation for engagement analytics, sentiment, attrition risk and AI-assisted HR workflows.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
